reasons: Position LTV 0.381 is well below the corridor act level 0.7 and even below target 0.5, with a 55.7% collateral price drop required to reach the 86% liquidation LTV.

The only fired screen on the live market is ETH/USD feed staleness at 1202 s vs a 1200 s max — a 2-second technical breach with the answer still positive; the pool price matches the oracle exactly (0.0% deviation), so there is no pricing divergence to act on.
Market health is normal: utilization 0.5946 is far below the 0.95 screen threshold, borrow APR is 0.58%, and no liquidity, oracle-quality, or borrow-rate problem exists beyond the marginal staleness.

Fresh text (venue status, published 2026-11-04, within window) reports all testnet markets operating normally with no open oracle or pool incidents; the Base status item describes only a scheduled Nov 5 upgrade with mainnet expected to remain operational.
Selling collateral or migrating the loan over a 2-second feed-age breach would be disproportionate given the position's large buffer; hold and let the feed refresh.

items.title: Testnet markets operating normally
items.text: Testnet markets operating normally | The live, backup and demo markets on Base Sepolia (deployments/testnet.json) accept supply and borrowing. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.

items.title: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed
items.text: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed | On 4 November the team's lender supply returned to the live and backup markets (13 USDC each) and the demo market (5,000 dUSDC) on Base Sepolia, and the executor moved to 0xA9bbabE6d75C5BA96CA095586284774c9D09D18b (deployments/testnet.json). All three markets accept supply and borrowing; the live market's public Uniswap 0.01% pool again holds the team's price band. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.
